subject: reasoning
question:
Ganesh starts from point A and drives 11 km towards the south. He then takes a right turn, drives 8 km, turns right and drives 15 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 4 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again?

(All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Ganesh starts from point A and drives 11 km towards the south.

He then takes a right turn, drives 8 km, turns right and drives 15 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 4 km and stops at point P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a21efc654758878d16d33261c0e1da096755861a7a4e1ed0b0a4257970f43df.png] 

Thus, Ganesh should drive 4 km (12 km - 8 km) in the west direction​ in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
